rationale: The single reply matches the hidden truth exactly: skin condenser in the side walls plus anti-condensation loop round the door frame, made warmer by the tight alcove, not a fault. It correctly frames the safety boundary (burning smell, warm plug/socket, discolouration, can't keep hand on it) as stop-and-unplug triggers, and points to the installation manual clearances and manufacturer warranty without recommending parts or an engineer. Hedging ('almost certainly') is well calibrated and nothing is invented; the only minor shortfall is that it closed the case without actually asking the customer about smell/plug/temperatures first, instead handing them a checklist, which is acceptable but slightly less rigorous than the ideal first step.
